mapper.select: select f.abbreviation, LOWER(f.code) code, f.name, f.remark, f.type, f.chart_length chartLength, f.not_null_flag notNullFlag, f.filter_type filterType, f.filter_index filterIndex, f.result_index resultIndex, f.identify_index identifyIndex from sys_layer_type_fields f where f.abbreviation = #{abbreviation} and f.delete_flag = 0
select f.abbreviation, LOWER(f.filter_type) filterType, f.filter_attr_key filterAttrKey, f.filter_attr_value filterAttrValue from sys_layer_type_attr_filter f where f.abbreviation = #{abbreviation}
select tbbh_ref from sys_layer_type t where t.abbreviation = #{abbreviation} and t.delete_flag = 0 limit 1
select area_ref from sys_layer_type t where t.abbreviation = #{abbreviation} and t.delete_flag = 0 limit 1
SELECT layer_area FROM sys_layer WHERE id = #{layerID} AND delete_flag = 0

select layer_name from sys_layer l left join sys_layer_type t on l.layer_type_id = t.id where t.abbreviation = #{abbreviation} AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.industry_code = #{industryCode} and l.delete_flag = 0 and l.nest_flag = 1 and l.category = 1 limit 1
mapper.insert: ALTER TABLE ${layerName} RENAME TO ${bakLayerName}; create table IF NOT EXISTS ${layerName} (like ${bakLayerName} INCLUDING indexes including constraints including comments including defaults);
DROP table IF EXISTS ${layerName}; ALTER TABLE ${bakLayerName} RENAME TO ${layerName};
mapper.update: update ${tableName} set minx = ST_X(st_astext(st_pointn(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(geom)), 1))), miny = ST_Y(st_astext(st_pointn(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(geom)), 1))), maxx = ST_X(st_astext(st_pointn(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(geom)), 3))), maxy = ST_Y(st_astext(st_pointn(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Envelope(geom)), 3))), calarea=st_area(st_transform(geom, CAST((FLOOR((ST_X(st_centroid(geom)) + 1.5) / 3) + 4488) AS INTEGER))) where calarea is null;
UPDATE ${tewc} set ${areaCode} = (${tewc}.calarea / tkq.calarea * tkq.${areaCode}) from ${tkq} as tkq where ${tewc}.bsm = tkq.bsm and tkq.gid is not null
mapper.select:
select count(1) from ${tableName}
and tbbh like concat('%',#{req.tbbh},'%')
SELECT l.layer_name FROM sys_layer l LEFT JOIN sys_layer_type t on l.layer_type_id = t.id WHERE l.delete_flag = '0' AND t.abbreviation in ('tkq','ckq','tewc')
